greeting: Hey there, I'm Justin. I'm a lifelong creative problem solver, currently working at Supper.
bio: In the past, I've been called a designer and filmmaker. Now, my world revolves around digital marketing and building new possibilities with artificial intelligence.
In my free time, I enjoy obsessing over music, tending to my garden, and spending time outdoors.
One thing I'm incredibly proud of is achieving over 20 million lifetime views on YouTube.
thoughts: Currently tinkering with Hermes, building automations and context-capture systems to make tech more intentional in my life.
All invasive plants are non-native. But not all non-native are invasive.
Picked up the XTEINK X4. E-Ink is magic. Finished On the Road recently and it rules.
We are living through the best time in history to be making things online.
